name: LP333 ID5 unary-channel one-hour follow-through
hypothesis: The hash-frozen ID5 unary-channel formula will reach SAT or proof-producing UNSAT within a 3600-second run now that the matched calibration reduced conflicts by 85.56 percent and removed proof-volume pressure.
evidence_unit: one hash-frozen ID5 full-PAF translation-gauged unary-channel formula under a one-hour proof-producing capacity window
claim_boundary: A verified terminal result decides only fixed multiplier family ID5 and its separately normalized coherent translated version. A timeout or artifact ceiling remains UNKNOWN and does not decide ID5, unrestricted LP333, or H668.

baseline.evidence: Code commit 597e49a; formula c8c083c7311e083ec5e0bb82d3fca863f2f07e821a30cf55aeb5d79a17778d8b; encoding metadata 170d61f0acedbbe5f445f76db1c115934f5f03d354ae8646a31b53c44921ab13; unary audit formula-bound at code commit 4277d0c.
baseline.measurement: The exact formula is UNKNOWN after 300 seconds, 279414 conflicts, 2146395219 propagations, and a 266805565-byte incomplete proof. The parent translation-only run had 1901171 conflicts.

intervention.one_change: Increase only the proof-producing wall ceiling from 300 to 3600 seconds for the already frozen and audited ID5 unary-channel formula.

controls.name: exact-input-binding
controls.purpose: Prevent the capacity follow-through from silently changing the successful structural mechanism.
controls.expected: Formula, metadata, generator, parent, channel audit, CaDiCaL, drat-trim, and SAT-control SHA-256 values equal the 300-second calibration bindings.

controls.name: calibration-justification
controls.purpose: Require local evidence before allocating the longer capacity window.
controls.expected: Matched aggregate conflicts equal 589442 versus 4081640 baseline, a reduction of at least 20 percent; ID5 proof bytes remain below 300000000 at 300 seconds.

controls.name: semantic-and-channel-controls
controls.purpose: Carry forward every correctness gate from the frozen formula.
controls.expected: Direct arithmetic, translation automorphism, sequential truth table, parent binding, exact clause reconstruction, XOR binding, and mutation rejection all remain PASS.

controls.name: adversarial-proof-control
controls.purpose: Detect a proof checker that accepts false terminal evidence.
controls.expected: Pinned drat-trim rejects an empty proof against the known SAT control before and after every decisive UNSAT replay.

controls.name: terminal-model-or-proof
controls.purpose: Keep the board claim tied to independently checkable evidence.
controls.expected: SAT requires direct verification of both 333-entry sequences and all 332 PAF shifts; UNSAT requires two accepted complete replays with fresh bogus-proof rejection.

terminal_outcomes.promote: All bindings and carried controls pass, and ID5 yields either a directly audited SAT model or a complete UNSAT proof accepted twice with fresh bogus-proof rejection.
terminal_outcomes.park: The solver returns a valid nonterminal result before any resource ceiling without SAT or UNSAT, so the fixed capacity experiment ends without tuning.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: The formula reaches 3600 seconds, 4 GiB RSS, 8 GiB proof bytes, or 1800-second replay ceiling without complete terminal evidence.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any input hash, carried semantic/channel gate, model verification, proof replay, or bogus-proof control fails.

stop_rules: Stop before launch if any frozen formula, metadata, audit, tool, parent, or calibration binding differs.
Terminate at 3600 solver seconds, 4 GiB observed RSS, or 8 GiB proof bytes.
Do not interpret or replay an incomplete proof.
Do not restart with a new seed or solver option after a nonterminal result.

next_actions.promote: Archive and independently recheck the terminal ID5 result; if SAT, construct and verify H668 before any submission preparation.
next_actions.park: Archive the nonterminal return and move to a different fixed family or proof-logged programmatic propagator.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the strict-UNKNOWN manifest and partial artifact hashes, then transfer the proven unary mechanism to a different family rather than raising this cap again.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest failed binding or evidence checker without rerunning the target until Gate A passes.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts and source-pinned repositories are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
